verdict_reason: New handshake wiring is correct — INS link hidden in stub mode, handshake errors mapped from allowlisted codes to hard-coded copy (no XSS surface), tests cover stub-mode, both handshake error codes and the link URL; the two findings are minor duplication and cross-feature copy coupling

todos.fix: Extract handshakeErrorMessage into ins-handshake.js (or a sibling module) and reuse it from both controllers so a new handshake error code only needs to be handled once
